# operator Agent Context

> TD-first map for agents. Start from tech design and capability intent before implementation files.

## Tech Design

- [Tech Design](tech-design): implementation source of truth.
- Validate: `aw td check libs/service-k8s/tech-design`.

## Capability Map

- [README](README.md): capability source of truth and product contract.

## Agent Workflow

- Capability next action: `aw capability next --project operator`.
- Readiness: `aw health --project operator`.
- Blockers: `aw health --project operator blockers`.

## Commands

- Test: `cargo test -p service-k8s`.

## Root Artifacts

- [llms.txt](llms.txt): generated by AW from TD-first project context.
